findings.title: Release build is debuggable
findings.explanation: isDebuggable = true in the release build type lets anyone attach a debugger and read app data via run-as. Google Play also rejects debuggable release bundles.

findings.title: Cleartext traffic permitted in release network security config
findings.explanation: The main config sets cleartextTrafficPermitted=true for all domains, and receipt images are fetched over http://. Traffic can be read or modified in transit. Disable cleartext in the main config, and use https for images.

findings.title: Exported ContentProvider exposes receipts without permission, with SQL injection
findings.explanation: ReceiptsProvider is exported with no read or write permission. Any app can query, insert, update and delete financial receipt data. The merchant path segment is concatenated into raw SQL, which allows injection.

findings.title: Exported HelpActivity loads attacker-controlled URL in WebView with JS bridge exposing the session token
findings.explanation: The activity is browsable and exported. The page comes from the pennyjar://help?page= query parameter or an intent extra and is loaded without validation. JavaScript is enabled and a PennyJar interface exposes sessionToken(). A malicious link can load any site that can then steal the user's auth token. Allowlist https://help host, and remove the token from the bridge.

findings.title: Hardcoded static AES key with ECB mode for note encryption
findings.explanation: The key is embedded in the code and can be extracted from the APK. AES/ECB leaks plaintext patterns and is not authenticated. Use a Keystore-held key with AES-GCM.

findings.title: Plaintext password stored in SharedPreferences
findings.explanation: The user's email and password are saved unencrypted. Combined with allowBackup, they can leave the device. Do not store passwords. Use the session token or Credential Manager.

findings.title: Hardcoded helpdesk API token and analytics token in the app
findings.explanation: A bearer token for the helpdesk API is embedded in the APK and can be extracted to create or read tickets. Proxy ticket submission through your backend and rotate the token.

findings.title: HTTP body logging includes credentials and tokens
findings.explanation: HttpLoggingInterceptor at Level.BODY logs login and register requests (passwords) and Authorization headers to logcat, with no build-type guard. The interceptor is also added after AuthInterceptor, so the auth header is logged.

findings.title: Backup CSV of expenses written to public shared storage
findings.explanation: Financial data is written unencrypted to the public Documents directory, readable by other apps with storage access. The code relies on WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE and requestLegacyExternalStorage, which scoped storage ignores at targetSdk 30+, so the code is also broken on modern Android. Use app-private storage or the Storage Access Framework / MediaStore.

findings.title: allowBackup enabled with no backup rules
findings.explanation: Auto Backup and adb backup can copy the app's data, including the credential store and the receipt database. Set allowBackup=false or add dataExtractionRules and fullBackupContent excluding sensitive files.

findings.title: Analytics runs before consent, and sends email and merchant data
findings.explanation: Mixpanel is initialised and tracks app_opened at startup without checking ConsentStore.analyticsAllowed. signedIn identifies the user by their email address, and expense_added sends the merchant name. Gate all analytics on consent and avoid PII. Update the Data safety form to match.

findings.title: Background location permission requested without clear need
findings.explanation: The app only needs a one-off foreground city lookup (getCurrentLocation), yet declares ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION and FINE location. Play requires a Permissions Declaration and justification for background location, and rejects it for unneeded use. Remove the background permission, and use coarse only.

findings.title: WebView remote debugging enabled unconditionally
findings.explanation: WebView.setWebContentsDebuggingEnabled(true) runs in release builds, which lets a connected debugger inspect the help WebView and its bridge.

findings.title: targetSdk 34 is below Google Play's current requirement
findings.explanation: The app targets API 34 although compileSdk is 37. Play requires new apps and updates to target a recent API level (35 or higher as of August 2025, and likely newer by now). Raise targetSdk and test the behaviour changes.

findings.title: Receipt downloads and no certificate pinning for API
findings.explanation: No pinning is configured for endpoints you control, which carry financial data and auth tokens. Decide whether pinning is warranted. Also, downloadTo accepts an arbitrary URL and sends the auth header to it through the shared client.
